positions.description:
Commerce and Accounts Server Engineering

Apple Services Engineering, Apple Media Products (AMP)

positions.title: Software Engineer, ASE Language Experience
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Helped ship 2 major features shaping the future of the iOS multilingual user experience.

Collaborated extensively with various teams spread around different organizations to collect and centralize on-device signals from sources such as Safari, Messages, Voicemail, Settings, and various Apple Services (Music, Podcasts, TV, Books) into a knowledge graph processing pipeline. 

Made various fixes to improve language detection, scoring and confidence determination algorithms, localization daemons, and created foundational infrastructure for sources to donate their language consumption (including 3rd party integrations).

Also assisted in the shipping and development of a bilingual arabizi latin to arabic script transliteration keyboard, assisting with model training and data cleaning/augmentation/generation pipelines

positions.title: Software Engineer,  Music Android
positions.description:
Evolve Rotational Program second rotation. Engineer on the  Music Android team.

- Worked closely with a senior engineer to profile, assess, and optimize a core component of the application
- Fixed bugs across the extremely vast domain of the app — having touched ExoPlayer & playback stack, library sync, downloads, and metadata.
- Helped in the development of new features, most notably the collaboration of Apple Music on Rivian

positions.title: Software Engineer, Apple Maps
positions.description:
Evolve Rotational Engineer. First Rotation on the Maps Platform Development team. Team oversees deployments, workflows, production automation, and traffic management for all of  Maps, owning various tools and platforms to support the organization as a whole.

Made various contributions to the team's arsenal of tools, improvements to overall quality of life, and implemented various features that gave visibility into our production stack.

Spearheaded the planning and development of a tool to automate triage for workflow failures across all of maps. Leveraged and worked with many teams cross-functionally, and put together a highly scalable and future proof project.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Assist instructor during lectures: monitoring class Slack channel, answering questions students might have, assisting during In-Class Programming Activities
• Compose "TA Review Guides" for each lecture (written-up summaries of lectures for student review)
• Host office hours and review sessions to answer student questions, help with homework, etc.

organizations.name: Management Leadership for Tomorrow
organizations.description:
Management Leadership for Tomorrow (MLT) is a national nonprofit that is transforming the leadership pipelines of more than 120 leading organizations by driving breakthrough results for individuals and institutions. 

MLT equips and emboldens high-achieving women and men from underrepresented communities—African American, Latinx, and Native American—to realize their full potential, to make a mark, and make a difference. MLT has convened a uniquely powerful and vibrant community of Rising Leaders—8,000 and growing—who are propelling change throughout our institutions, communities, and nation.

organizations.name: Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers
organizations.description: SHPE changes lives by empowering the Hispanic community to realize its fullest potential and to impact the world through STEM awareness, access, support, and development. SHPE’s vision is a world where Hispanics are highly valued and influential as the leading innovators, scientists, mathematicians, and engineers.
